scope: Distinct small-strain linearized central-force/collinear-bending model with quasi-static internal memory. Not a reproduction of nonlinear H100 results or physical seconds.
null_definition: Runtime field homogeneous_relaxation_null_retention is the fully relaxing exp(-5) reference. Matched-fraction homogeneous null r+(1-r)*exp(-5) is added explicitly in derived CSV. Both are analytic whole-energy rescaling controls, not numerical trajectories.
statistical_limits: Four graph seeds per size/setting; finite MCMC interventions, not demonstrated equilibrium ensembles. Pointwise bootstrap intervals unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Complete-case matching excludes unresolved/nonrigid states. Hub bias co-changes clustering; triangle arms preserve degree/direction but can change bending motifs.
